help.title: Register Map Guide
help.intro: The register map defines which Modbus registers to read from the device and how to interpret the data.
help.address: Address: The Modbus register address (0-65535) to read from.
help.function: Function: Modbus function code — Holding (read/write) or Input (read-only).
help.metric: Metric: A unique name for this measurement (e.g., voltage, current, temperature).
help.datatype: Data type: How to interpret the register bytes (Int16, Uint16, Int32, Float32, etc.).
help.wordOrder: Word order: Byte order for multi-register types — Big endian or Little endian.
help.scale: Scale: Multiplier applied to the raw value (e.g., 0.1 to convert 230 to 23.0).
help.unit: Unit: Measurement unit for display (e.g., V, A, °C, kWh).
